workflow.name: Key manager — Key Inventory Report (PDF, branded)
workflow.description: End-to-end report pipeline. manual_trigger fans out two parallel branches. (A) Branding: text_input -> web_browse (headless Chromium loads a brand site) -> prompt_template + llm_call + output_parser turn the page's title, meta tags, image URLs and text into a JSON brand kit (brand, logo URL, primary and accent color, font, tagline). (B) Keys: mcp_tool calls the key service's `list_keys` tool -> code_node (Python, stdlib only) counts the keys by cloud, by algorithm and by age (<30d / 30-90d / 90-180d / 180-365d / >365d). The two branches meet at three chart nodes (Vega-Lite, server-side SVG): keys by cloud (bar), keys by algorithm (donut) and key aging (bar); the two bar charts take their colors from the brand kit. A final prompt_template places the brand values and the chart SVGs in one HTML page, pdf_output prints it with Chromium, and the Output returns the PDF as a data URL. Before it works for real: (1) point the mcp_tool connection at your key service's MCP server (add a secretRef if it needs one), (2) set the text_input to your brand URL (defaults to https://example.com), (3) give the llm_call a provider and key. A user_prompt sent with the run replaces the brand URL.
